$comment: languages-world-2 (11 November 2026): the WhatsApp allergen guard’s trigger words for MACEDONIAN (mk-MK): алерг (алергија, алергичен), нетолеранција / интолеранција, чувствителен, целијакија, анафилакса, без <allergen> (без глутен, без лактоза, без млеко / млечни, без јајца, без ореви, без кикирики…), безглутенск, не содржи, може да содржи, траги од, вкрстена контаминација, безбедно, погоден / соодветен за, не смеам / не можам да јадам — plus the Latin-typed Macedonian customers use (alergija, bez gluten, ne sodrzi). ѓ and ќ fold to г and к on both sides. Bare без / bez is NOT a stem (без кромид is a preference), nor bare содржи (a presence question). OPTION B, as every other language: absence / safety words only, NOT the bare allergen names (a presence question may reach the AI, which answers only from the tags and gets the caveat). Matched with the Unicode normaliser. caveatWords: a tagged label of the codex allergen set (stored in English, lower case) → the words a reply may use for it (matched on the raw lower-cased reply, so written as the AI writes them). The country has no allergen set of its own yet, so caveatWords are for 'codex' (as MX, SG, HK, MY, TH and AE).
